note: DRY-RUN ONLY dispatch manifest skeleton (machine-checkable readiness package, WO-INFRA3-NL5-READINESS-R1, issue #65). Nothing in this manifest authorizes or triggers any calculation: host U1 is not assigned, R2 is WAITING_HOST / NOT_ACTIVE, dispatch is BLOCKED by the frozen S->F->D/R/V->A chain. All numbers re-derived from the canonical frozen protocol at manifest creation; statuses are honest (HOST_NOT_ASSIGNED / NOT_MET); no PASS is declared anywhere.

campaign.scientific_question: Distributional equivalence of per-replica median hinge angle between author platform U1 and external platform U2 (paired fresh seeds); primary variants 0b/32b, controls 11b/53b; 74b excluded (NOT_MEASURED / KNOWN_GAP).

authoritative_contract.role: single source of truth for seeds, bootstrap seeds, replacement pools, cursors and digests; this dry-run manifest duplicates none of them

freeze_chain.R: MISSING (fresh SCIENTIFIC REVIEWER(F) does not exist yet)
freeze_chain.V: MISSING (fresh independent VERIFIER(F) does not exist yet)
freeze_chain.A: MISSING (dispatch authority record schema v3 does not exist yet)

variants.status: NOT_MEASURED / KNOWN_GAP - production FORBIDDEN until separate arm-manifest-v2 repair WO

legs.platform: P-B = outenemy (independent external session from release package; workspace never copied from author)
legs.note: outenemy is EXTERNAL_U2_ONLY and is never proposed as author executor

run_id_rules: <NNNN> = 4-digit zero-paired replica index i of the frozen seed record (paired design: identity i on P-A and identity i on P-B form pair i); replacement runs continue the deterministic identity stream from next_candidate_index and keep the same template
bootstrap leg runs use nl5v02-<leg>-<variant>-boot (one bootstrap seed per variant, 4 total)
attempt id = <run_base> or <run_base>-R<n> (n >= 1); attempt reuse FORBIDDEN, including after FAILED_TECHNICAL; append-only ledger
actual seed identities, bootstrap seeds, replacement pools, cursors and digests are NOT duplicated here - they are bound at dispatch from the authoritative contract + seed record

enumeration.method: deterministic cross product legs x variants x replica indices
enumeration.verification: tests/test_infra3_nl5_readiness.py enumerates the cross product from this manifest and asserts 296 unique run ids and max_runs budget consistency

input_digests.note: Placeholder by design: no workspaces/inputs exist yet (dry-run). At dispatch every run binds its input digests (topology, initial configuration, oxDNA input file, seed identity) from the authoritative contract + seed record via the pinned digest contract; digests are recorded in the per-attempt raw manifest (path, sha256, size, producer, retention) and the append-only ledger.

attempt_semantics.ledger: append-only; reuse of run/attempt id forbidden in all cases including FAILED_TECHNICAL

replacement_policy.identity_source: frozen replacement pool, next index in order from next_candidate_index (raw N+1 FORBIDDEN); both legs of the new pair are planned

stop_semantics.protocol_change_demand_after_data: STOP + new WO + new freeze revision
stop_semantics.r2_not_active_or_authority_chain_incompl: HARD_BLOCKED (both legs gated on R2 ACTIVE + dispatch authority)
stop_semantics.additional_dispatch_gates: fresh Reviewer(F) PASS + fresh Verifier(F) VERIFIED + authority record (lifecycle S -> F -> R/V -> A)
